# The 20 s per-test hang budget kills xdist workers on every CI run

## Symptom (pristine `origin/main` @ 6a5c88027c5)

The gating `pytest (ubuntu-latest, py3.13)` leg — the only one adding `--cov=rebar` — fails
every run with ~11 worker deaths (`[gwN] node down`, `worker 'gwN' crashed`) on a drifting
set of whole-tree-scanning tests, with ZERO `Failed: Timeout` lines (runs 32583448507,
32585303586). The integration tier shows the same deaths. Main is red for every change.

## Root cause — CONFIRMED (full evidence trail in this ticket's comments)

**Part 1 — the budget sits inside the band of legitimate costs.** Commit `6a5c88027c5`
(story 73b8-2d79-3046-44ce) cut the budget 300 s -> 20 s in `pyproject.toml` and both
`_build-and-test.yml` lanes. The parent commit's own green run (32581500417, `--timeout=300`,
16182 passed, zero crashes) measures ~14 tests at 18.7-29.93 s of `call` time on this leg.
`timeout_func_only` cannot help: the body IS the whole-tree scan.

**Part 2 — `timeout_method = "thread"` expires a test via `os._exit(1)`** (pytest_timeout.py:542),
killing the xdist worker; only the `signal` method reports `Failed: Timeout`. So an expiry can
NEVER surface as a timeout verdict — zero `Failed: Timeout` is a prediction of the mechanism.
Reproduced locally with a 3-armed discriminating experiment (see comments).

**Part 3 — a config-only restore cannot pass its own gate.** Change 2115 PS1 carried exactly
that restore and FAILED its own Verified run 32587991195 with the same signature: the Verified
gate executes the workflow files from TRUSTED MAIN (headSha 6a5c88027c5; job 97067339850 log
line 989 still ran `--timeout=20 --timeout-method=thread`), and pytest-timeout precedence is
CLI > INI, so main's stale flag overrode the patchset's ini. The full precedence is
**MARKER > CLI > env > INI** (`_get_item_settings`, pytest_timeout.py:388; verified
empirically, incl. marker-applied-at-collection under `-n 2 --dist worksteal`), so the budget
must ride an item MARKER applied from the repo's own tree to be effective from the patchset
alone.

## Plan

Restore the 300 s value bug 89d5-61da-b621-47f8 established ("dwarfs the slowest legitimate
test"), keep story 73b8's ini keys, and add the mechanism that makes the ini authoritative:

1. `pyproject.toml` — `timeout = 300`; comment cites the measured 29.93 s worst case.
2. NEW `tests/_timeout_floor.py`, called from `tests/conftest.py`'s
   `pytest_collection_modifyitems`: when the effective non-marker budget (CLI > PYTEST_TIMEOUT
   env > ini, pytest-timeout's own order) is positive and BELOW the ini budget, add the ini
   budget as `pytest.mark.timeout(budget, method=<ini>, func_only=<ini>)` to every item
   without an explicit `timeout` marker. FLOOR, not blanket: a blanket marker would silently
   LOWER the live lanes' larger calibrated CLI budgets (900/600/1800/3600 s) since
   marker > CLI; `--timeout=0` (explicit disable) stays respected.
3. `_build-and-test.yml` — REMOVE `--timeout=20 --timeout-method=thread` from both shared-tier
   lanes (single source; drift becomes impossible).
4. `tests/unit/test_timeout_budget.py` — `_INI_BUDGET_SECS` = 300; marker-override arm
   out-of-process with a small generated budget (in-tree it would sleep past 300 s); NEW arms:
   a hostile tighter `--timeout` no longer kills an unmarked ini-legitimate test (and DOES
   without the hook — negative control), and a looser CLI budget still wins.
5. `tests/unit/test_timeout_budget_headroom.py` (NEW) — budget >= 2x the measured 29.93 s
   worst case AND still a real guard (<= 600 s, thread method).
6. `tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py` — hang-guard sweep: a lane with no explicit
   `--timeout=` is guarded by the ini keys (asserted present, positive, thread method in the
   same test); lanes with explicit flags still require the thread method. Shared-tier parity:
   the two lanes must carry NO timeout flags.
7. `docs/local-dev-env.md` — document the 300 s value and the floor.

`timeout_func_only = true` deliberately KEPT (follow-up 797b-bbc4-01cf-42d5 owns the
fixture-phase gap). The loadgroup worker-death hang is filed as cac1-6391-7944-470e.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `[tool.pytest.ini_options].timeout` is 300; verified by
      `test_timeout_budget.py::test_the_configured_budget_is_the_measured_one`.
- [ ] Budget >= 2x the measured 29.93 s worst legitimate body and <= 600 s with thread method;
      verified by `test_timeout_budget_headroom.py` (both tests).
- [ ] An unmarked test whose body fits the ini budget survives a hostile tighter `--timeout`
      CLI flag (fix effective from the patchset alone); verified by
      `test_a_stale_tighter_cli_flag_cannot_undercut_the_ini_floor` incl. its no-hook negative
      control, and locally by a 25 s probe under
      `-n 2 --dist worksteal --timeout=20 --timeout-method=thread` exiting 0 with zero
      `node down` lines.
- [ ] A deliberately larger CLI budget is not lowered by the floor; verified by
      `test_the_floor_is_not_a_ceiling`.
- [ ] An unmarked over-budget test with no CLI flag is still killed by the ini alone; verified
      by `test_an_unmarked_over_budget_test_is_killed_by_the_ini_alone`.
- [ ] `@pytest.mark.timeout(N, func_only=True)` still overrides ini and CLI; verified by
      `test_a_marked_test_may_outrun_the_ini_budget`, completing in under 30 s.
- [ ] Both `_build-and-test.yml` shared-tier lanes carry no `--timeout`/`--timeout-method`
      flags; verified by `test_the_shared_tier_lanes_carry_the_ini_timeout_budget`.
- [ ] Every CI pytest lane has a per-test hang guard (explicit flag with thread method, or the
      asserted ini keys); verified by `test_every_ci_pytest_lane_has_a_per_test_hang_guard`.
- [ ] The change's own Verified run: the ubuntu py3.13 default-suite leg reports zero
      `worker '.*' crashed` and zero `node down` lines, and the integration-tier jobs reach a
      terminal conclusion within their `timeout-minutes` (no hang to the job cap) — while
      still executing main's stale `--timeout=20`, so a green run is itself the
      discriminating proof of the floor.

## Verification

    pytest tests/unit/test_timeout_budget.py tests/unit/test_timeout_budget_headroom.py \
           tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py -q
    pytest tests/scripts -q -n 4 --dist worksteal
